en.title: Netflix Drops Gothic YA Horror Romance 'Sid & Zoey' from Horror Titans
en.summary: Get ready for a dark, seductive new YA series blending supernatural scares with forbidden romance. Netflix has officially greenlit 'Sid & Zoey,' an eight-part series from creators Jon Kasdan, Jason Blum, James Wan, and J.J. Abrams.
en.body:
Netflix is diving headfirst into the YA supernatural space with **Sid & Zoey**, an eight-episode series that promises a potent mix of gothic romance and chilling horror. The streamer officially greenlit the project after a fiercely competitive bidding war, bringing together some of the biggest names in modern genre entertainment. At the helm is creator, showrunner, and executive producer **Jon Kasdan**, known for his work on *Solo: A Star Wars Story*. He's joined by a powerhouse production team, including **Jason Blum** and **James Wan** for Blumhouse Atomic Monster, the studio behind *The Conjuring* universe and the recent *Obsession*, as well as **J.J. Abrams** and his team at Bad Robot, responsible for *Star Trek* and *Castle Rock*.

## Unraveling the Dark Charm of 'Sid & Zoey'

The series centers on Sid, a teenager described as "seductive, sophisticated, and amoral," who is sent to live in a seemingly idyllic Mississippi town with his mother's family. There, he encounters Zoey, the sharp-witted, punk-rock daughter of a local police chief. Despite an immediate, undeniable mutual attraction, the two find themselves drawn into a hidden, darker world lurking beneath the town's picturesque surface. This mysterious underworld presents a paranormal puzzle that could prove dangerous for them both, hinting at secrets that run deeper than anyone imagines.

The logline alone suggests a narrative that will explore themes of forbidden desire, hidden darkness, and the allure of the unknown, all within a YA framework. With **Blumhouse** and **Bad Robot** involved, viewers can anticipate high production values and a commitment to delivering genuine scares alongside compelling character drama. The pedigree of the producers alone is enough to set expectations sky-high for this ambitious project.

## What This Means for YA Fans

The arrival of **Sid & Zoey** is a significant moment for fans of supernatural YA romance. The combination of a compelling, mysterious plot and the backing of industry heavyweights like **Wan**, **Blum**, and **Abrams** positions this series as a potential breakout hit. It taps into a popular genre that thrives on complex relationships, high stakes, and a touch of the uncanny. The focus on narrative arcs and character development, spearheaded by **Kasdan**, suggests that this won't just be a series of jump scares, but a story with real emotional depth that will keep viewers hooked and debating theories online.

## What's Next

While specific release dates have not yet been announced, **Sid & Zoey** is expected to premiere in 2026. Fans eager for more supernatural intrigue and gothic romance should keep an eye on official Netflix announcements for casting news and production updates.

content_raw: Picture: creator, showrunner, and executive producer of Sid & Zoey , Jon Kasdan Netflix is teaming up with some of the biggest names in modern horror and sci-fi for its latest young adult venture, Sid & Zoey . Blending supernatural scares with a gothic romance, this highly anticipated eight-part series comes from creator Jon Kasdan alongside powerhouse producers at Blumhouse Atomic Monster and Bad Robot. Here is everything we know so far about the series so far. Following a highly competitive bidding war , Netflix has officially greenlit Sid & Zoey , an eight-part young adult supernatural horror romance. The new series, part of the streamer’s expanding wave of YA content, is created by Jon Kasdan (Solo: A Star Wars Story) , who will serve as showrunner, writer, and executive producer. Kasdan is backed by a powerhouse team of executive producers. Jason Blum, James Wan, and Rob Hackett are on board, representing Blumhouse Atomic Monster, the modern horror titans behind The Conjuring franchise and the recent viral hit Obsession . Also producing are J.J. Abrams (Star Trek) , Rachel Rusch Rich ( Castle Rock) , and John Shiban (Ozark) for Bad Robot. Picture (L to R): Jason Blum, James Wan, J.J. Abrams, executive producers on Sid & Zoey What is the plot of Sid & Zoey ? Netflix has released a logline for the series: “The series will follow Sid, a seductive, sophisticated, and amoral teenager from New York, as he’s sent to live with a police chief and his family in the idyllic Mississippi town where his mother grew up. Among them is the chief’s sharp-witted, punk-rock daughter, Zoey. Resisting their mutual attraction, Sid and Zoey find themselves drawn into a dark, hidden world beneath the town’s picture-postcard facade — and a paranormal puzzle that may well get them killed (if they don’t kill each other first). It’s a fish-out-of-water tale focused on an unlikely pair with plenty of scares.”  Who are the cast members of Sid & Zoey ? At the time of writing, Netflix has yet to announce any cast members. What is the production status of Sid & Zoey ? Development Filming Scheduled Filming Ongoing Post-Production The series is currently in active development, and no potential filming dates have been reported. It could take several weeks or even a few months before we learn more about the series’ production schedule. When will Sid & Zoey be released on Netflix? Since Netflix has only just announced the series, we won’t learn its official release date or even a release window for quite some time. Once we get news of the production schedule, it will be easier to make an educated guess about when we can expect the series to be released. Until then, our best estimate is that Sid & Zoey will be released on Netflix sometime in 2028. Are you excited for the release of Sid & Zoey on Netflix? Let us know in the comments below!
